rewrite_rules.description: List of signal rewrite rules in format 'old_signal:new_signal'. Example: '10:15' to rewrite SIGUSR1 to SIGUSR2. Use ':0' to ignore a signal. Derived from '-r/--rewrite' option in dumb-init(1).

single_child.description: Run in single-child mode, forwarding signals only to the direct child. Derived from '-c/--single-child' option.

verbose.description: Print debugging information to stderr. Derived from '-v/--verbose' option.
